name: grin-accio-gateway
description: Accio (Script 052) gateway — /tor/ forwarder with an SSRF destination allowlist and a response-header allowlist, plus the /listen WebSocket rail and per-wallet /wallet/<suffix>/v2/foreign inbound URL. Replaces the SOCKS-Proxy, Block-Access and Allow-Headers nginx C modules and the unlicensed WebSocket-Listener daemon.
